messages:
noah (sec): heads up, we
re seeing a flapping SCIM deprovision loop across a handful of EU tenants since the 02:00 deploy. user count ~15.
tess (idp): saw a spike in SAML auth failures right at 02:01 UTC; assertion audit shows Audience check failing.
omar (eng-infra): can you paste a sample failure?
tess (idp): one sample from idp logs (redacted):
```
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Issuer>https://idp.example.com/ </saml:Issuer>
  <saml:Subject>
    <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">bob@customer.com</saml:NameID>
  </saml:Subject>
  <saml:Conditions>
    <saml:AudienceRestriction>
      <saml:Audience>https://app.redwood-inference.com/ </saml:Audience>
    </saml:AudienceRestriction>
  </saml:Conditions>
</saml:Assertion>
```
tess (idp): note trailing spaces on Issuer and Audience (idp templating bug).
lina (platform): our SP validates audience strictly (no trim). That would cause session creation to fail -> SCIM sees user missing -> deprovision -> reprovision loop.
noah (sec): any KMS errors correlated? we saw a couple of decrypt warnings but not widespread.
omar (eng-infra): grabbed SCIM events: two example lines:
```
2026-03-22T02:02:07Z WARN scim:deprovision user=bob@customer.com reason=missing-session
2026-03-22T02:02:09Z INFO scim:provision user=bob@customer.com action=create
```
noah (sec): vuln triage note: if an attacker controlled IdP templates they could craft Audience with null bytes or spaces to bypass some lenient parsers elsewhere. We should normalize.
tess (idp): agreed. quick mitigation: we can push a config to trim whitespace on Audience/Issuer generation in IdP templates (low-risk).
lina (platform): quick hotfix: change SP audience validation to be tolerant for trailing whitespace for existing tenants while we fix IdP templates. Feature flag: app.saml.audience_trim_compat=true.
omar (eng-infra): planning a short deploy. deploy-bot: starting rollout to eu-prod (canary 1/3)
deploy-bot: canary 1/3 succeeded
deploy-bot: canary 2/3 succeeded
deploy-bot: canary 3/3 succeeded
lina (platform): rolled audience_trim_compat=true globally at 02:10 UTC. Monitoring now.
tess (idp): pushed IdP template fix to staging; will schedule tenant patch for 02:45 UTC.
noah (sec): action items for postmortem:
- export all SAML assertions during 01:50-02:20 UTC (tess)
- snapshot SCIM provision/deprov events (omar)
- run a scan for other IdP tenants with trailing whitespace in templates (tess)
- add SP-side normalization & canonicalization tests in CI (lina)
- create KMS decrypt health alert threshold (noah)

omar (eng-infra): scim dedupe note: some tenants have orphaned service accounts because of mid-loop reprovisions. Will run dry-run merge job tomorrow 00:30 UTC.
lina (platform): will open a config rollback plan in case trimming causes unexpected matches; revert window 02:50-03:10 UTC.
noah (sec): vulnerability mitigation: add parser hardening to reject control characters (\u0000..\u001F) in SAML fields earlier in the pipeline. Low risk, aim to ship in next sprint.
tess (idp): tenant patch scheduled, I'll DM the compliance owner for signoff on template changes.
noah (sec): good. Add this to incident tracker with severity: P2 (service impact limited).
